description:
OPT and EAD can apply  
 

 The Role 
 An exceptional Front End Developer with web-based application development, HTML5/JS, major HTML5 framework (e.g. Angular, Ember, React, Backbone) experience is required for this exciting role in a rapidly growing company! 
 As a senior member of the Application Development team you will play a key role in our transition to next generation web based application standards (HTML5/CSS3/ES2015). 
 Play a lead role in researching and implementing next-generation HTML5 frameworks.  

 Mock-up, design and implement complex, yet intuitive, user interface layouts.  

 Develop creative new techniques to visualize large, complex data sets.  

 Collect and document requirements from internal staff and client subject matter experts.  

 Manipulate and transform data using Javascript, Java, SQL, and dynamic scripting languages.  

 Front End Development  
 Experience with web-based application development. 
 Experience with HTML5/JS and experience with a major HTML5 framework (e.g. Angular, Ember, React, Backbone)  

 Proven track record of delivering quality, easy to use web based software.  

 Deep understanding of object oriented coding and design patterns.  

 Experience with service oriented architectures and design concepts.  

 Experience with Tomcat or other Java-based middleware is a plus.  

 Energy industry experience or experience in equities/commodities trading is a plus. 


 Front End Developer

 Multiple Openings for OPT/CPT/H4/L2/EAD/Citizen's.
